items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: Sundu had his band then. He had, what's his name was Sundu's band? The Boozang Kings.

ctx.x: Did they do that to make the rent ever? Eh? Did they ever do that so they could make the rent in different places?
No, well they'd get together and probably say it was like a little club. See? Sundu had his band then. He had, what's his name was Sundu's band? The Boozang Kings.
Oh yeah. Just kids, huh? Youngsters.
